scope: Rosemary platform password creation and SDK 0.5.0 field validation

timing.firstCheck: first focusout with a nonempty value
timing.afterFirstCheck: recheck on input; defer IME composition until compositionend
timing.empty: clear every result and invalid state; next nonempty edit waits for focusout again

placement: Requirements, rule results, verification codes, CAPTCHA challenges and recovery actions belong directly below their related field.

requirements: 仅使用英文字母、数字和英文符号，不含空格
字母、数字、英文符号中至少包含两类
password.normalization: none; never trim, rewrite or truncate passwords
password.login: Check presence only; do not reject existing credentials using password creation complexity rules.

exampleNickname.scope: Illustrative nickname/name limits, not a new platform-wide character policy.
